headline: Answer every part of every resident letter from approved wording
capabilities: Triages letters, emails, forms and phone notes into one queue
Splits multi-part enquiries so every question is answered
Finds approved past responses for each question and cites them
Routes unanswered points to the owning team with the question
outcomes: Every question in every letter is addressed in the draft
Approved wording is reused with a citation instead of rewritten
Gaps reach the right team in minutes and become precedent
why_try: The demo walks one multi-part resident letter from the queue to a cited draft reply, with the unanswered question routed to the right team and nothing sent.

Correspondence officers in Microsoft Teams or Microsoft 365 Copilot
Approved correspondence records and response library
Officer review, sign-off and sending in Outlook
